<thought>Based on the mass (C₁₂H₁₄Cl), 13C NMR (six aromatic and six aliphatic carbons), and ¹H NMR (four aromatic protons, a CHCl at ~2.6 ppm, and ten aliphatic protons at ~1.3 ppm), the structure is a phenyl‑substituted cyclohexane with a chlorine on the carbon adjacent to the phenyl‑bearing carbon. The SMILES that encodes this connectivity is: c1ccc(cc1)C2C(Cl)CCCC2.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccc(cc1)C2C(Cl)CCCC2</final_answer>
